form.current-chamber: IN THE SENATE OF THE UNITED STATES

action.action-desc: Mr. Merkley (for himself and Mr. Markey), under authority of the order of the Senate of September 30, 2026, introduced the following joint resolution; which ordered was read twice and referred to the Committee on Foreign Relations

form.official-title: Providing for congressional disapproval of the agreement for civilian nuclear cooperation between the United States and the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia pursuant to section 123 of the Atomic Energy Act of 1954.

section.text: That, the Congress does not favor the proposed agreement for cooperation transmitted to the Congress by the President on September 14, 2026.
